recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future rendered build again shows a visual defect, investigate the diagram rendering or generated artifact pipeline rather than treating FHIR-19475 as an unapplied current-source change.
issue_request: FHIR-19475 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction from MnM requesting repair of the broken UML diagram for STU3 datatypes section 2.24.0.20 Other Types; Jira records the auto-approved resolution and a comment that Grahame fixed it.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-19475 was found. The matching historical application is Grahame's 2018-12-13 commit 496d1c2bad6baf6ce12653c46c7960e301dc83f1, which changed source/datatypes/types3.diagram from direction hints to explicit coordinates; this aligns with the Jira comment and the affected source artifact.
additional_context: The current source/datatypes.html Other Types section includes [%diagram datatypes/types3.diagram 6dt%], and source/fhir.ini actively maps types3 to datatypes/types3.diagram. The current diagram file lists DataType, Extension, Narrative, and Reference with explicit coordinates. MnM minutes from 2019-01-29 independently list the old tracker for the Section 2.24.0.20 Other Types SVG classes being lumped together as Persuasive and previously fixed. Direct Jira-key Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current built source already contains the repaired, active Other Types diagram source. No source edit was warranted, and editing generated-looking diagram/SVG artifacts alone would be outside the workflow's source-change threshold.
